title: Return to Zhao
summary: Wang Lin returns to the Heng Yue mountains and the Country of Zhao after 400 years, kneels before his parents' memorial as Tie Zhu and swears the Teng family will pay in blood. At the Wang ancestral home he meets Wang Liaoyi, descended from his fourth uncle Wang Tiantu, and finds that she, like everyone in the capital, has lost her spiritual root. He keeps his old promise to his uncle: he heals her and her dying grandfather, the patriarch Wang Zefu, and sets a Spirit Gathering Formation over the Wang residence. Zhang Kuang of the old Heng Yue Sect recognises him and explains that the Tian Dao Sect captured him and drained his cultivation to make pills, and that the sect is stripping the capital's spiritual roots. Tian Dao elder Lu Shiming arrives to punish him and boasts that the Teng family stands behind the sect, and Wang Lin traps his men in a Six Soul formation, lets Xu Liguo feast, and sets out to destroy the Tian Dao Sect and more.
events: Wang Lin returns to Zhao and swears revenge at his parents' memorial
He meets Wang Liaoyi, descendant of his fourth uncle
The capital's people have all lost their spiritual roots
He heals Wang Zefu and sets a Spirit Gathering Formation over the Wang home
Zhang Kuang tells him the Tian Dao Sect is behind it
Lu Shiming threatens him in the Teng family's name; Xu Liguo devours his men
Wang Lin heads for the Tian Dao Sect
cultivation: Zhang Kuang: Qi Condensation, down from Core Formation after the Tian Dao Sect used him for pills. Lu Shiming: late Core Formation.
